review.title: Record a decision
review.help: Choose a decision for this referral. Nothing is chosen for you.
review.confirmBody: You are about to record the decision "{{decision}}" for this referral. It is kept under your name.
review.conflict: The referral is not waiting for a decision, or a different decision is already recorded. Refresh and try again.
review.decidedNote: A decision has already been recorded.

revoke.title: Revoke this identity confirmation?
revoke.body: This moves the record back to unverified, so a match on it is reviewed by a person. Nothing that is already linked is undone.
revoke.conflict: That revoke conflicts with an earlier request. Refresh and try again.

task.not_configured: No review task was raised: the task settings are not configured yet.
task.on_record: Nothing new was recorded: this was already done, or the record was already unverified.

revoke.accepted: The request was accepted. Check the record for its current state.

identity.title: Identity
identity.emptyDuplicates: There are no possible duplicates to show.
identity.emptyMerges: There are no merges to show.
identity.differentPerson: A different person from the one who proposed this merge must approve it.
identity.approveBody: This links the two records. It asks for a fresh authenticator code first.
identity.unmergeBody: This breaks the link between the two records. It asks for a fresh authenticator code first.
identity.approveConflict: That approval was refused. It may already be approved, or you may have proposed it. Refresh and try again.
identity.unmergeConflict: That could not be done. Refresh and try again.
identity.flagged: {{n}} bookings, holds, waitlist entries and match-review rows were recorded while the link was active; a review task lists them, and nothing is undone.

placeholder.revokeReasons: [PLACEHOLDER: the wording of these reasons is not final. To be confirmed by the clinic.]

problem.step_up: A fresh authenticator code is needed to do this. Nothing was changed.
